title: Consolidate stream backpressure hints and retry preset templates across Python/TS/Go SDKs
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Cross-language inconsistency in stream backpressure hints and retry presets was causing client confusion and subtle production regressions when teams migrated code between Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. This PR introduces a compact, explicit surface for 'stream-advice' (an optional per-request metadata envelope), a small RetryProfileCompiler that emits canonical presets (fast, balanced, conservative), and ergonomic helpers across the three SDKs so callers get the same defaults and names regardless of language. Main goals: 1) Parity of defaults and environment variable names, 2) Small ergonomic helpers to set common retry/backoff shapes, 3) Maintainable codegen-friendly templates so future SDKs can pick up presets automatically. What changed (high level):
- Introduced a lightweight 'stream-advice' header that transports backpressure hints and a client-visible 'preferred-batch-ms' integer. The wire representation is opaque JSON under X-Stream-Advice but SDKs expose typed helpers. Example (Python usage): client.stream(messages, stream_advice=StreamAdvice(preferred_batch_ms=10, urgency="balanced"))
- Added RetryProfileCompiler: takes a small declarative profile (max_attempts, initial_backoff_ms, backoff_multiplier, jitter) and compiles to SDK-specific retry configs. Compiler lives in /internal/retry/presets and emits JSON templates checked into each SDK package for codegen.
- Converged env vars and flags: REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_PRESET (values: fast|balanced|conservative), REDWOOD_STREAM_HINTS_DISABLED for compatibility.
- SDK surface changes: * Python: new module redwood.retry.presets and StreamAdvice dataclass, high-level helper client.with_retry_preset("balanced") returns wrapped client. * TypeScript: exported RetryPresets and streamAdvice() factory in @redwood/sdk (ts) with typed interfaces and improved JSDoc. * Go: added retry/presets package and StreamAdvice struct, plus functional options on client.New to pick presets.
- Auth interaction: preserved existing token rotation behavior; RetryProfileCompiler emits header-safe recommendations only. No auth protocol changes.
- Tests: added cross-sdk smoke harness (scripts/ci/smoke_cross_sdk.sh) that runs a small end-to-end scenario against local dev runtime with streaming toggled. Also added unit tests for compiler and per-SDK adapters.
Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-1138) - [x] Added unit tests for compiler and adapters - [x] Added cross-sdk smoke CI job (gated) - [x] Backwards compatibility flag (REDWOOD_STREAM_HINTS_DISABLED) - [x] Release notes drafted Why this approach: By keeping the runtime semantics optional and encapsulated behind a small header + typed helpers we avoid making breaking wire changes while getting strong ergonomics and parity for developers migrating across SDKs. Rollout plan: Feature gated off by default in hosted canary, opt-in in dedicated/private during initial rollout. Monitoring: Added telemetry events when a non-default preset is used (sdk.preset.{name} with anonymized counts).

review_comments: Ravi Patel: Can we avoid adding another env var surface? Suggest reusing REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_PRESET and adding a value 'none' instead of REDWOOD_STREAM_HINTS_DISABLED.

Maya Chen (author): Good call. Updated to reuse REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_PRESET and accept 'none' as disabled in the SDK adapters; preserved explicit REDWOOD_STREAM_HINTS_DISABLED only for legacy toggles in runtime (kept for canary compatibility).

Owen Kim: Tests look good, but the TS JSDoc needs an example showing how streamAdvice interacts with streaming backpressure in the browser. Also request: add an integration test where preferred_batch_ms is respected by the local runtime mock.
Maya Chen: Added browser-focused example to README and expanded smoke script to assert preferred_batch_ms in the runtime mock. PTAL.
Sofia Martínez: Approve after CI green. Observability hooks look fine; please ensure telemetry counts are low-cardinality.
Liam O'Connor: Minor nit: go client option API should return an error only if invalid preset name; otherwise default. Fixed in follow-up commit.
ci_checks: ci: unit (py/ts/go) — initial run: fail (missing ts types) — rerun after fix
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge (squash commit: 'consolidate: unify stream hints + retry presets across sdks')
release_notes: User-facing: Introduces optional stream-advice header and cross-sdk Retry Presets (fast|balanced|conservative). SDKs provide ergonomic helpers: Python: StreamAdvice dataclass + client.with_retry_preset; TypeScript: streamAdvice() factory and RetryPresets export; Go: presets package + client option. Backwards compatible by default; set REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_PRESET=none to disable. Internal: adds RetryProfileCompiler and cross-sdk smoke job.
notes_for_release_team: Docs page added at docs/sdk/streaming-advice.md. Recommend calling out new env var mapping and example snippets in the 2026.02 SDK changelogs. Coordinate canary rollout with runtime team (ENG-1140) to enable server-side hint acceptance for the first 48h before flipping on telemetry aggregation.
test_instructions: Run scripts/ci/smoke_cross_sdk.sh against a local dev runtime (see docs/sdk/streaming-advice.md). Unit tests in each SDK package were added; run pytest -q in redwood-sdk-python and npm test in redwood-sdk-typescript and go test ./... in redwood-sdk-go.
